project.description: Renders the gateway/operations/query env files for a stack and uploads to S3. Each template resolves from the stack-specific S3 override, shared S3 override, or infrastructure repository fallback. Always renders all three together (shared tokens are minted per run). Re-running rotates QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN / PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN / AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT — always redeploy the three services afterwards.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git hash of the infrastructure repo to checkout

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
assume_role
# Get the introspection token from the PSAMA database (same derivation as Teardown # and Rebuild). The token is never echoed: it is a live credential. db_app_user_json=$(fetch_secret "$database_app_user_secret_name") picsure_db_username=$(extract_field "$db_app_user_json" "username") picsure_db_password=$(extract_field "$db_app_user_json" "password") picsure_db_host=$database_host_address
if [ -z "$picsure_db_username" ] || [ -z "$picsure_db_password" ] || [ -z "$picsure_db_host" ]; then echo "Error: One or more required database variables are empty." >&2 exit 1 fi
initialize_shared_db_config "${picsure_db_host%:3306}" "$picsure_db_username" "$picsure_db_password" picsure_token_introspection_token=$(get_token_by_uuid "$application_id_for_base_query") unset_shared_db_config
# Fail closed: rendering with an empty token produces a gateway.env whose introspection # calls PSAMA rejects with 403, which surfaces to users as 502 on authenticated routes. if [ -z "$picsure_token_introspection_token" ]; then echo "Error: no introspection token found for application ${application_id_for_base_query}." >&2 echo "Run the Update PIC-SURE Token Introspection Token job to mint one, then re-run this job." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Get logging API key from logging.env in S3 (same derivation as Teardown and Rebuild). # The key is never echoed: it is a live credential. if ! aws s3 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env" /tmp/logging.env >/dev/null; then rm -f /tmp/logging.env 2>/dev/null || true echo "Error: could not read s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env." >&2 echo "That object is hand-maintained (there is no terraform template for it); confirm it exists, then re-run this job." >&2 exit 1 fi logging_api_key=$(grep -oP '^LOGGING_API_KEY=\K.*' /tmp/logging.env || true) rm -f /tmp/logging.env 2>/dev/null || true
# Fail closed, like the introspection token above. This previously defaulted to the literal # string "disabled", which rendered a gateway.env whose audit events pic-sure-logging # rejects with 401 -- silently, because the logging client logs the failure and drops the event. if [ -z "$logging_api_key" ]; then echo "Error: logging.env defines no non-empty LOGGING_API_KEY." >&2 echo "Rendering would ship a gateway.env whose audit events pic-sure-logging rejects with 401. Fix logging.env, then re-run this job." >&2 exit 1 fi
cd app-infrastructure/template-renderer
# Resolve each editable template independently: stack-specific S3 override, # then shared S3 override, then the checked-out repository version. download_s3_template() { local object_key=$1 local destination=$2 local aws_error local candidate
candidate=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$destination")/.template-download.XXXXXX") if aws_error=$(aws s3 cp "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key}" "$candidate" 2>&1 >/dev/null); then if [ ! -s "$candidate" ]; then rm -f "$candidate" echo "Error: s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key} is empty; refusing to use it." >&2 return 2 fi mv "$candidate" "$destination" return 0 fi
rm -f "$candidate" case "$aws_error" in *"An error occurred (404)"*|*"An error occurred (NoSuchKey)"*|*"An error occurred (NotFound)"*) return 1 ;; esac
echo "Error: could not read s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key}; refusing to fall back after a non-missing-object AWS error." >&2 return 2 }
resolve_template() { local template_prefix=$1 local template_file=$2 local download_status
if download_s3_template "${template_prefix}/${TARGET_STACK}/${template_file}" "templates/${template_file}"; then echo "Using stack-specific S3 template for ${template_file}" return 0 else download_status=$? if [ "$download_status" -ne 1 ]; then return "$download_status" fi fi
if download_s3_template "${template_prefix}/${template_file}" "templates/${template_file}"; then echo "Using shared S3 template for ${template_file}" return 0 else download_status=$? if [ "$download_status" -ne 1 ]; then return "$download_status" fi fi
echo "No S3 template found, using repo version of ${template_file}" }
resolve_template "configs/gateway/templates" "gateway.env.tftpl" resolve_template "configs/operations/templates" "operations.env.tftpl" resolve_template "configs/query/templates" "query.env.tftpl"
# This render job is stateless (each run inits from empty state), but the local # terraform.tfstate transiently holds live secrets -- DB app-user credentials, # the introspection token, the logging key, and the full rendered env contents. # Remove it on exit so it never lingers in the browsable Jenkins workspace. tfstate_dir="$PWD" trap 'rm -f "$tfstate_dir"/terraform.tfstate "$tfstate_dir"/terraform.tfstate.backup' EXIT
terraform init -input=false
# All three env files render together: the shared tokens are minted per apply # and must stay identical across gateway.env, operations.env, and query.env. terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false \ -var="stack_s3_bucket=${stack_s3_bucket}" \ -var="environment_name=${environment_name}" \ -var="target_stack=${TARGET_STACK}" \ -var="env_private_dns_name=${env_private_dns_name}" \ -var="render_auth_hpds=false" \ -var="render_open_hpds=false" \ -var="render_visualization=false" \ -var="render_picsure_services=true" \ -var="picsure_token_introspection_token=${picsure_token_introspection_token}" \ -var="logging_api_key=${logging_api_key}" \ -var="app_user_secret_name=${database_app_user_secret_name}" \ -var="include_open_hpds=${include_open_hpds}"
reset_role
